poses.prompt: Raise a frosted blue perfume bottle and present it with the other hand.
poses.fullPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one new transparent character pose for the Scene Studio product photography card in an established portfolio series. Reference 1 is the master identity and outfit. Reference 2 shows the exact waist-up framing and polished semi-realistic 3D editorial portrait look of a neighboring card; do not copy the laptop or pose. Same recognizable adult East Asian man, same proportions, features, short textured black haircut, clean-shaven, same navy overshirt with two fine ivory vertical stripe chest panels over an ivory polo. Distinct pose: torso turned three-quarters to the viewer's left, eyes looking with quiet interest at a single small rectangular frosted pale-blue glass perfume bottle raised in his right hand just below eye level on the viewer's left; his other forearm low with relaxed open palm under it as if presenting the product. Keep the bottle offset from the face and the face clearly visible, soft natural smile. The perfume bottle has a simple metallic cap and no label. Waist-up portrait reaching lower edge, entire hair, both elbows, both hands and perfume bottle visible, centered with minimal transparent margins and framing matched to the second reference. Soft neutral studio lighting and the same restrained colors, polished material details. Exactly one person. True transparent alpha background, no backdrop, furniture, card, border, effects, text, watermark, extra products, or laptop.

poses.prompt: A traveler planning a hotel stay: standing three-quarter left, looking pleasantly down at a folded open pale-blue city map held in both hands at chest height. A small navy travel bag strap on one shoulder. NO waving.

An AI product researcher: body turned slightly right, holding a magnifying glass in right hand at chest height and inspecting a small blank pastel image-preview board held in left hand. Thoughtful engaged expression. No waving.

A camera product reviewer: holding a small lavender mirrorless camera with BOTH hands near chest, checking its controls with an interested smile, body angled left. All camera and hands fully visible. No waving.

A web builder: working on an open silver laptop held at waist/chest height, one hand supporting laptop, other hand typing on keyboard, looking toward viewer with a confident slight smile, torso angled right. Laptop lid simple with no logos. No waving.

A meticulous researcher taking notes: holding a small open pale-blue notebook in left hand and writing in it with a pen in right hand, head slightly lowered toward page, three-quarter left pose. No readable text. No waving.

A product planner presenting a roadmap: holding a mint clipboard with a simple unlabelled flowchart of colored boxes, right hand points with a pen to a box on clipboard, looking at viewer, torso angled right. No waving.
An analytical thinker: thoughtful face, right hand lightly touching chin, left arm folded supporting elbow, gazing slightly upward to left, a natural relaxed thinking stance. NO props, NO waving.

An interaction designer: holding a dark drawing tablet in left arm, right hand draws on the tablet with a stylus, torso angled slightly left, gaze to screen with focused friendly expression. Clearly show tablet and stylus. No waving.

An industry writer reading news: holding an open folded newspaper at chest height with both hands, attentive slightly reflective expression looking over its edge toward viewer. Newspaper has abstract column lines, NO actual words or letters. Torso angled left. No waving.
Selecting favorite finished photos: holding three printed landscape photographs naturally in both hands at chest height, looking down with a warm smile.
poses.fullPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create ONE replacement pose for the portfolio article card 'from taking good pictures to wanting to publish'. Use the supplied image ONLY as the identity and visual style reference. Preserve this same young adult East Asian man's exact recognizable adult face, short black cropped haircut, clean-shaven appearance, navy overshirt with ivory fine-stripe chest panels and ivory polo shirt, polished semi-realistic 3D illustrated style. New action: he stands relaxed in a three-quarter LEFT-facing pose, holding THREE small printed photographs fanned naturally in BOTH HANDS at mid-chest, considering and selecting a favorite finished photo. He looks down at the photographs with a warm natural smile. The photos show simple pastel landscape thumbnails only. Both hands and every photograph clearly visible; clean anatomically coherent fingers. Square 1:1 medium waist-up composition, complete head and elbows visible with 8 percent margins, torso reaches bottom edge, subject fills most of canvas, head about 22 percent of height. Absolutely NO phone, NO selfie pose, NO waving, NO camera, no books, no extra people. TRUE transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no circle, no halo, no floor, no border, no text or lettering, no logos. Soft even studio lighting. Only generate the character and the held photographs.

poses.prompt: A creative image editor: holding a small painter color palette in left hand and a short paintbrush in right hand, brush poised near palette, imaginative confident expression, torso angled left. Palette colors restrained lilac mint blue cream. No waving.

A reader waiting for the next story: seated posture visible only from waist up, gently holding a closed lavender book against chest with both hands, warm relaxed smile looking toward viewer, torso angled right. No waving.

An organizer preparing documents: cradling three pastel document folders in left arm and arranging the top folder with right hand, looking toward the folders, friendly focused expression, torso angled left. Folders have no writing. No waving.

A practical tool builder: holding a compact mint-and-navy toolbox by its handle in left hand near waist and holding a small silver wrench in right hand at chest height, friendly upbeat smile, torso angled slightly right. No waving.

An inviting conversation gesture: standing three-quarter left, left hand gently placed over upper chest, right hand extended slightly outward palm up as if welcoming someone into a conversation. Looking directly at viewer with warm smile. NO raised waving hand, no props.
